messages:
maria: heads up — AcmeX just asked if we can run Orpheus-24B (open checkpoint) inside their private VPC with 8-bit quant. They want low tail latency for streaming chat (target ~150ms/token). They also reported hallucination regressions on our hosted run. Can ML team do a quick scout to decide viability and a short action list? cc @devin @sanjay

devin: added to our queue. couple clarifying Qs: do they require persistent KV cache across requests? also which tokenizer/checkpoint exactly (customer ticket?)

sanjay: for 8-bit I'd start with PTQ (GPTQ) + bitsandbytes 8bit fallback and measure perplexity + factuality suite. For latency, run bs=1 streaming with kv-cache enabled to measure tail. If hallucination shows up, we'll run targeted factuality tests and selective FP16 for sensitive layers.

lucy: I can run a smoke harness on sandbox. need: 1) sample prompt set, 2) model s3 path, 3) tokenizer. ETA: 1k prompt sweep + perf numbers by EOD tomorrow if I get inputs today.

maria: customer provided sample set in the ticket: https://acme.support/issue/12345 — 200 prompts (mostly technical Qs). tokenizer: tkm-orpheus-v1, checkpoint: s3://acme-models/orpheus-24b/v1.ckpt. they flagged ~15 cases that hallucinate.

devin: noted. infra Q: do we have optimized kernels for Orpheus attention variant? if not, kernel tune + perf delta planning needed. also need to confirm KMS/audit requirements for private deploy.

sanjay: we have base kernels for Orpheus-v1 family but not fully tuned for seq-len=1 streaming. i'll queue a kernel-tune job and run the PTQ sweep. quick command i plan to run:

```
rdwctl quant --model s3://acme-models/orpheus-24b/v1.ckpt --method gptq --bits 8 --out /tmp/orpheus-24b-8bit
rdwctl perf --model /tmp/orpheus-24b-8bit --bs 1 --streaming --profile tail
rdwctl eval --suite factuality_v2 --prompts s3://acme-support/1724009876/prompts.json
```

oncall-bot: deploy job started: run-quant-scout-1724009876 on infra-cluster-7 (ETA ~45m)

lucy: quick note — if they want Private deployment we need to confirm KMS/HSM choices. @maria can you check whether HSM is required or just KMS + audit logs? :thinking_face:

maria: they require at-rest encryption + audit logs, no HSM initially. updated ticket. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

devin: proposed rapid plan: 1) PTQ + bitsandbytes 8bit sweep (sanjay) 2) bs=1 streaming perf (devin infra) 3) factuality & few-shot tests with customer prompts (lucy) 4) short report with perf numbers, perplexity delta, and recommended config for private deploy (me). owners assigned. we'll post results here.

sanjay: will attach initial perplexity deltas and a short note. if delta > 2% we'll try mixed 4-bit/8-bit selective fallback.

lucy: ack — i'll upload results & a short table here and put logs at s3://redwood-sandbox/scouts/1724009876/ for anyone who wants early access.

maria: thanks all — priority is to confirm whether 8-bit meets their quality bar. if not, we'll propose a hybrid config or dedicated FP16 pool.

(reacted with :eyes: by devin)
